not_triggered.reason: 'Diabetic? No' (p2); no glucose medications on MAR.
No infection, antibiotics or fever documented; afebrile on vitals grid.
'Requires O2? No' (p2); SpO2 95–98% on room air.
No acute event, troponins, AFib or BP medications. Chronic CAD only (see if-available EKG).
'Fractures: No', 'Recent surgery: No' (p8). Disc degeneration has no specific rule.
Foley: No (p2); no dialysis. Continence answer ambiguous; see questions.
POLST: Full Code, Full Treatment (p10); no hospice.
No stroke, seizure, TBI or neurosurgery.

questions.question: Is the patient currently in an acute hospital or a skilled nursing facility?
questions.why: Forms say hospital admit; face sheet and MAR read like a 36-day facility stay. This changes which swabs are required.

questions.question: Is the dementia diagnosis current, and what is the patient's orientation level today?
questions.why: Face sheet lists F03.90; both referral forms say no cognitive impairment; AOx left blank.

questions.question: What symptoms led to the psychosis diagnosis? Any auditory or visual hallucinations, especially command hallucinations?
questions.why: F29 on risperidone, symptoms never described.

questions.question: Has the patient expressed any suicidal ideation?
questions.why: Depression is the referral reason; no SI screen in packet.

questions.question: Is the patient under, or being considered for, a conservatorship or FSP?
questions.why: Packet is silent; patient has dementia and psychosis diagnoses.

questions.question: Can the patient manage her own medications, including the as-needed lorazepam and temazepam?
questions.why: Forms say yes; chart shows all meds given by nurses.

questions.question: What was the result of the second-step TB skin test?
questions.why: Only one 0 mm reading is legible.

questions.question: Does the patient use an assistive device?
questions.why: PT says no device; PM&R note says 'with an appropriate assistive device'.

questions.question: Is the patient continent of bowel and bladder?
questions.why: Answer on the referral form is ambiguous.

request_to_referrer: Send a negative MRSA swab result.
Send a negative COVID swab collected within 24 hours of the planned transfer.
Send a psychiatry note or physician note confirming the patient is psychiatrically stable on current medications, including a suicide-risk screen.
Send a current orientation (AOx) exam and clarify whether the dementia diagnosis is current.
Tell us whether the patient is under, or being considered for, a conservatorship or Full Service Partnership.
Confirm whether the patient can self-administer all medications, including as-needed lorazepam and temazepam.
Send a current discharge medication list with doses.
Send recent progress notes (the ones included are fragments).
Send the second-step TB skin test result.
Send an OT evaluation and a cosigned copy of the PT note.
Confirm whether the patient is in an acute hospital or a skilled nursing facility.
Complete the current IHH referral form (RC0725).
If available: an EKG, and any notes describing the patient's 'sudden mood changes'.
